decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website, so the firm made little visible commitment to it. It sits outside the inclined-lift line the firm appears to be building, and the firm has already shown with A and B that it will cut peripheral vehicle products quickly.

The inclined furniture lift has its own page and anchors a coherent lift line in which the firm has invested visibly, so management will likely put weak results down to temporary pandemic-era conditions and keep it.
The inclined building material lift shares technology and customers with the other lifts and was presented prominently, so dropping it would undercut the firm's announced direction.

The truck-mounted furniture lift probably needed the largest investment in the lift family and was given its own page, so sunk costs and the need to justify the decision favour keeping it despite uncertain demand.
